corpus_findings: Every one of the twenty CIP-007-6 Parts has at least one operator section in its population, so no Part can carry the `no_operator_side` case as an ABSENT operator side. Part 5.2 is the minimum at exactly one, and that one section restates the requirement verbatim rather than describing a practice -- which is the same answer shape reached honestly, from real material.

Every operator edge in the CIP-007-6 population carries link_status `proposed`. There are no `approved` edges. Acceptance does not depend on approvals by design; the population is reported with its standing.

The R2 VSL row (csection-94e31ab3fe6fb6051478, heading `2. Table of Compliance Elements`) exists in the captured revision but is anchored to NO requirement, so it is not in any population and the reader is never handed it. It is reachable only through `compliance_search`.
Part 2.1's requirement row (csection-754b5967f6905d4c376e) is anchored with relation `applicable_systems` rather than `governing`. The text is present and citable; the relation label is the anomaly.
